# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-config-doc.py from schema.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Config version: **2**. Settings live in `~/.config/nowplaying-viz/config.json`:

```json
{ "version": 2, "preset": "lookas", "audio": { "apps": [] }, "overrides": {}, "presets": {} }
```

- `preset` — a built-in preset (`package/contents/code/presets/*.json`) or one of yours.
- `overrides` — any option below, applied on top of the preset, written as nested objects
  (`bars.glow.enabled` → `{"bars": {"glow": {"enabled": true}}}`).
- `presets` — your own presets, same shape as `overrides`.
- `audio.apps` — apps the visualizer listens to (empty = whole system).

Invalid values are replaced by the default (or clamped to the range) and reported by the
warning icon on the widget. Colours use web notation; `AA` is opacity (`00` invisible, `ff` opaque).

| `bars.circle.enabled` | bool | `false` | bool |  | Circular |
| `bars.circle.size` | real | `0.45` | 0.1 … 0.9 (shown as %) | `bars.circle.enabled` is true | Center hole |
| `bars.circle.rotation` | int | `0` | 0 … 360 ° | `bars.circle.enabled` is true | Rotation |
| `bars.count` | int | `24` | 4 … 128 |  | Number of bars |
| `bars.areaRatio` | real | `0.45` | 0.15 … 0.85 (shown as %) |  | Width of the bar area |
| `bars.width` | int | `0` | 0 … 60 px |  | Bar width (0 = automatic) |
| `bars.gap` | int | `4` | 0 … 30 px |  | Gap |
| `bars.radius` | int | `0` | 0 … 30 px |  | Corner radius |
| `bars.align` | enum | `"bottom"` | `bottom` — Bottom<br>`center` — Center (mirrored)<br>`top` — Top | `bars.circle.enabled` is not true | Alignment |
| `bars.reverse` | bool | `false` | bool |  | Reverse order |
| `bars.symmetric` | bool | `false` | bool |  | Symmetric (bass in the middle) |
| `bars.minHeight` | int | `2` | 0 … 20 px |  | Minimum height |
| `bars.heightScale` | real | `1.0` | 0.3 … 2.5 (shown as %) |  | Height |
| `bars.alpha` | real | `1` | 0.1 … 1 (shown as %) |  | Opacity |
